currentState: Only current-state observations can answer; any rules-authored supersession makes the older observation ineligible.
historicalEvents: Only historical-event observations can answer; later state changes never erase historical observations.
subjectiveBeliefs: Only subjective-belief observations can answer; they are not world-state facts.
unclassified: Never infer a class for legacy rows; do not use them as evidence.

matching.fallback: CJK bigram or separated word overlap

ambiguity: Return a bounded candidate list; do not claim one candidate is certain.
incompleteArchive: Never convert an incomplete scan into abstention or a complete result.
forgettingMode: Decay-gated: authorized observations below the pinned accessibility floor answer with the deterministic forgotten template.
